name: Strategy
description: Strategy describes itself as the world's first and largest Bitcoin Treasury Company, and its economics are now those of a leveraged bitcoin holder: at June 30, 2026 it held about 846,000 bitcoin (cost $63.9 billion, market value $49.7 billion), financed by selling common stock, preferred stock (STRK, STRF, STRC, STRD) and convertible notes. It also still runs an enterprise analytics software business, only $477 million of revenue in 2025 and a small operating loss of about $41 million before bitcoin marks (derived). Reported profit is driven almost entirely by changes in the bitcoin price: a $5.4 billion unrealized loss in 2025 and $22.8 billion in the first half of 2026. The software business no longer pays for the company's cost of capital; preferred dividends were $630 million in H1 2026 and are supported by a USD cash reserve and, since July 2026, bitcoin sales.

employees.note: 1,539 employees, 448 in the US and 1,091 outside (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Enterprise analytics software
businessLines.how: Sells software as term or perpetual licences, as cloud subscriptions recognised over the service period, and as support and consulting; subscription revenue is growing while licences and support shrink.
businessLines.description: AI-powered business intelligence and analytics software sold as licences, cloud subscriptions, support and consulting.

businessLines.name: Bitcoin treasury
businessLines.how: Does not earn income on the bitcoin; the company bets on price appreciation and pays holders of its preferred stock and notes out of new capital raises, its software cash flow and cash reserves.
businessLines.description: Holds bitcoin as the treasury reserve asset; funds purchases with stock, preferred stock and convertible note issuance.
businessLines.revenueNote: Produces no revenue; gains and losses are marked through operating income since ASU 2023-08 adoption on 2025-01-01 (unrealized loss $5,403,476K FY2025; prior-year impairment $1,789,862K).
